---
title: "User guide"
---

A `CampbellCochraneModel` object is a specification of the economy, and
calling `solve` does not change the object.

```python
import geap

model = geap.CampbellCochraneModel()
res = model.solve()
print(res.summary())
res.compare("equity", "bill").premium
```

## Specify

You pass keyword arguments to change selected parameters of
`CampbellCochraneModel`, and parameters you omit keep the Campbell and
Cochrane (1999) values. The numbers you pass are annual, and the
solver converts them to monthly.

::: {#dc003f5c .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import geap

print(geap.CampbellCochraneModel())
print(geap.CampbellCochraneModel(gamma=5))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
CampbellCochraneModel(gamma=2, phi=0.87, Sbar=0.057)
CampbellCochraneModel(gamma=5, phi=0.87, Sbar=0.090)
```
:::
:::


## Solve

You call `solve` to obtain expected returns from the specification.
The method iterates the price-consumption ratio of the consumption
claim on a surplus grid, and it then annualizes a long monthly path.

::: {#445a2620 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
res = geap.CampbellCochraneModel().solve()
print(res.expected_returns)
print(res.compare("equity", "bill").premium)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
equity    5.767648
bill      0.944432
dtype: float64
4.8232161452076205
```
:::
:::


A counterfactual is a new model, and `replace` returns the new model
without changing the original parameters.

::: {#b1fe5174 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
base = geap.CampbellCochraneModel()
print(base.replace(gamma=5).gamma)
print(base.gamma)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
5
2.0
```
:::
:::


## Simulate

You call `simulate` to draw finite annual samples from the same
monthly economy used by `solve`. `compare` works on the draws as it
works on the object returned by `solve`.

::: {#37328873 .cell execution_count=4}
``` {.python .cell-code}
sim = geap.CampbellCochraneModel().simulate(n_samples=15, years=40, seed=0)
print(sim.compare("equity", "bill").premium)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
4.69592309839344
```
:::
:::


The source is Campbell and Cochrane (1999), and the bibliography is on
[References](../reference/references.qmd).
